title: The N-Prime Graph Question is equivalent to the Prime Graph Question
summary: Let $G$ be a finite group and let $V(\mathbb ZG)$ be the group of normalized units of its integral group ring. We prove that every $N$-prime arc of $V(\mathbb ZG)$ either already occurs in $G$ or admits commuting witnesses of distinct prime orders.
